findings.detail: 429 status returned by code (rate_limited) is not documented in the spec
findings.evidence: handlers/payouts.go: CreatePayout returns http.StatusTooManyRequests when X-Debug-Ratelimit=1; spec /payouts post responses only list 201/400/409

findings.detail: 409 'Duplicate reference' is documented but the handler never returns 409
findings.evidence: spec /payouts post responses include 409; handlers/payouts.go CreatePayout has no 409 path

findings.detail: Spec marks accountNumber, bankCode, amount, currency as required in PayoutRequest, but the handler only validates refere
findings.evidence: spec components.schemas.PayoutRequest.required; handlers/payouts.go CreatePayout only checks req.Reference

findings.detail: 422 'Refund not permitted' is documented but the handler never returns 422
findings.evidence: spec /refunds post responses include 422; handlers/payouts.go CreateRefund has no 422 path

findings.detail: Spec marks payoutId and amount as required in RefundRequest, but the handler performs no validation
findings.evidence: spec components.schemas.RefundRequest.required; handlers/payouts.go CreateRefund only decodes the body

findings.detail: 404 is documented but the handler never returns 404
findings.evidence: spec /customers/{id} get responses include 404; handlers/accounts.go GetCustomer always returns 200

findings.detail: Response header X-Signature is set by the handler but not documented in the spec's 202 response
findings.evidence: handlers/misc.go TestWebhook: w.Header().Set("X-Signature", ...); spec /webhooks/test 202 response has no headers

findings.evidence: spec /payouts post security: ApiKeyAuth; handlers/routes.go registers CreatePayout with no auth middleware
